verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own cloud-directory page says it consolidates "human, machine, and agent" identities, so it directly claims agent identities as first-class directory objects. That claim is a single marketing line, and the pack contains no documented patterns for securing agent access. The password vault is aimed at company secrets generally, not agent token vaulting, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented cross-app access patterns for agents, agent token vaulting, scoped/least-privilege agent credentials, in-depth first-party docs on agent identity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)

citations.quote: Consolidate all identities—human, machine, and agent—secure access, and device management into one automated source of truth.
